_meta.title: Sweden: hate crime reports with an identified hate motive, by municipality
_meta.measures: Number of police reports in which Brå identified a hate-crime motive, by the municipality where the crime took place, and per 100,000 residents, for 2020, 2022 and 2024 (Brå samples every other year).
